AI 工作台接到视频任务时，原有入口分散且插件网关与通用 MCP 不同，容易找不到流程或沿用错误参数。本次内置本仓唯一视频调用指南，CLI/MCP 返回同一完整正文与摘要，现有入口引导先读，运行载荷只包含这份固定指南。

每条短片的镜头数、逐镜时长与编排继续由正式管线按本次需求自主规划；30 秒、6 镜、五版及 17–30 分钟仅为历史计时样本，不新增生产默认、全局超时或验收闸。指南核对人物、商品、平台、时长、账号调性、声音及特殊要求，说明正式前期、付费渲染、恢复、后期与真实交付的边界。

固定读取只接受空输入，不接受调用方路径；缺件、产品或版本冲突、UTF-8/大小/链接边界失败均保留错误。新增回归接入原仓实际 CI 测试入口；必需 CI 和主干保护保持原口径。

验证：
- 当前提交 `4ae528d2963ac327bd2faec2012a91095b157d7a` 的离线回归 53/53 通过，0 失败或跳过。
- 真实源码 CLI/MCP 全文和 SHA 一致；精确载荷复制及错误路径回归通过，生成器检查、diff 检查、暂存及提交范围秘密扫描通过。
- 当前 Codex 会话和独立复核已审查变更及直接依赖，0 未解决发现；结构化实际测试及审查回执通过既有交付队列 handoff，云端原 CI 与准确候选合并继续为硬门禁。

边界：本次没有模型、供应商、TTS、ASR 或新媒体调用；没有移植其它仓生产机制。载荷测试中的编译器是受控 fixture，不冒充完整签名安装包、桌面 GUI 或真实新片生产验收。回滚为 revert 本任务提交。

任务卡：#139（T-2026-1007-0001）。

正式 v0.1.2 签名发行误拒 CNB 返回的受保护 main 完整引用，真实成功视频任务又因下载超时中断；S3屏幕UI事实拒绝后的正式局部后期在黑边与人物黑衣连通时找不到唯一候选。

精确兼容 main/refs/heads/main 并保持原保护/SHA/tag/Release/签名校验；媒体组件只重试已成功任务的GET。补充局部定位候选路径，仍以完整逐帧像素、真实定位/修复结果/完整合同身份审核决定能否接入后期，不重复生成，不把局部修复等同完整合格。保留原片、原请求摘要及所有拒绝。

已有产品所有者修复合入发布授权，影响发布信任项显式review；正常平台三门禁与精确合并树通过后合入，普通Revert回滚。本隔离仓不回流公共基座。原生Mac/Windows Runner及签名配置仍缺，不能把代码/tag或只读预检称为签名安装包已发布。

- `scripts/ci/cnb-desktop-release.mjs`
- `scripts/ci/cnb-desktop-release.test.mjs`
- `packages/video-studio/src/media-download.ts`
- `packages/video-studio/src/media-download.test.ts`
- `packages/video-studio/src/video-surface-repair.ts`
- `packages/video-studio/src/video-surface-repair.test.ts`
- `scripts/tools/full-chain-film.mts`
- `docs/tasks/T-2026-1006-0850.md`

当前已通过发行/finalizer21项、媒体/成功回执/正式CLI51项和视频TSC，实际CNB main+v0.1.2只读绑定通过；局部定位追加验收完成后补最终真实回执。测试替身不冒充实际签名发行。

Closes #133

pull.title: fix(growth): journal image acceptance before download [T-2026-1007-0918]
pull.body:
Paid portrait image generation retried POST after ambiguous network errors and did not persist the provider URL until the download succeeded. The runtime now journals the complete compiled request before one POST and saves the accepted URL before downloading. Download/cache/file failures recover from that same URL, including across run folders and independent processes. Unknown acceptance and missing legacy receipts prohibit automatic resubmission. Image result journals use private atomic writes, fsync, exact scope and request validation; dead locks may recover only with known acceptance. Studio supplies a stable journal root. Fault tests inject providers and make no live paid requests.

Paid portrait image generation retried POST after ambiguous network errors and did not persist the provider URL until the download succeeded. The runtime now journals the complete compiled request before one POST and saves the accepted URL before downloading. Download/cache/file failures recover from that same URL, including across run folders and independent processes. Unknown acceptance and missing legacy receipts prohibit automatic resubmission. Image result journals use private atomic writes, fsync, exact scope and request validation; dead locks may recover only with known acceptance. Studio supplies a stable journal root. Fault tests inject providers and make no live paid requests.

pull.body:
The shared vendor prototype bridge kept the first Studio run's callbacks and planning settings for concurrent runs. Each asynchronous run now freezes its own creative-target or explicitly strict policy, bounds, event callback and log in AsyncLocalStorage. Authored metadata is cloned, the completeness principle travels with the brief, and malformed or conflicting settings fail before any vendor call. Default creative-target preserves complete 28/32/35-second plans around a 30-second target. Actual production CJS tests cover both the Vitest loader gap and asynchronous interleaving. Matching dependency files from PR144 and PR148 are included with identical contents for independent source compilation; PR150 owns the downstream requirement/prompt policy propagation.

patch.originalBody:
Paid portrait image generation retried POST after ambiguous network errors and did not persist the provider URL until the download succeeded. The runtime now journals the complete compiled request before one POST and saves the accepted URL before downloading. Download/cache/file failures recover from that same URL, including across run folders and independent processes. Unknown acceptance and missing legacy receipts prohibit automatic resubmission. Image result journals use private atomic writes, fsync, exact scope and request validation; dead locks may recover only with known acceptance. Studio supplies a stable journal root. Fault tests inject providers and make no live paid requests.

pull.title: fix(growth): atomically publish complete paid generation lock owners [T-2026-1007-0918]
pull.body:
A competing process could open a generation lock between O_EXCL creation and writing its owner JSON, producing a false corruption error while safely refusing a duplicate paid request. Fsync a private owner file and atomically link it to the final lock name without replacing any existing owner. Apply the same publication to recovery fences. A deterministic child-process test pauses the owner halfway through writing and proves the competing process still completes exactly one journaled operation. Genuine corrupt, unknown, alive and unacknowledged owners remain protected. No paid provider call.

The CLI could shorten model-generated performances to match an approximate total duration, freeze source tails, and detach paid receipts when a run folder changed. Preserve each source clip at its actual speed and duration, reject automatic retime/freeze/overlap before writing output, and use separate authored end cards and embedded covers. Record the actual plate prompt instead of a possibly missing spec file. Default rendered acceptance runs no quality model or identity/ASR re-review; real execution and provenance errors remain failures. Covers, presentation assets, BGM loudness and separate variant typography/music are frozen in the post plan. Reviewed prerequisite helper and cine-KB copies are included to make this source independently compile and pass the same native regression; they match their separate fixes. The common journal lock uses the separately published PR164 atomic owner publication; its deterministic race test is included unchanged.
